def LongestIncreasingSubsequence (a : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond (a)) : Int :=
  let rec aux : List Int → Int := fun l =>
    match l with
    | [] => 0
    | [x] => 1
    | x :: xs =>
        let rec findMax (rest : List Int) (current : Int) (currentLen : Int) : Int × (List Int → Int) :=
          match rest with
          | [] => (currentLen, fun _ => currentLen)
          | y :: ys =>
              if y > x then
                let (maxLen, nextMap) := findMax ys y (currentLen + 1)
                if maxLen > currentLen then
                  (maxLen, fun z => nextMap z)
                else
                  (currentLen, fun z => currentLen)
              else
                findMax ys x currentLen
        let (maxLen, _) := findMax xs x 0
        maxLen
  a.toList.foldl (fun acc x => aux (x::[])) 0
